pedals.axis.rudder.name: Rudder
pedals.axis.rudder.note: rocker arm over the main shaft; rudder axis has no axis letter in the manual (no input)

pedals.axis.brake_left.name: Left toe brake
pedals.axis.brake_left.note: left pedal plate (upper left), manual Ry

pedals.axis.brake_right.name: Right toe brake
pedals.axis.brake_right.note: right pedal plate (lower right), manual Rx

source: JoyPro curated on the maker's photo (2026-10-11), Cyber Taurus 32 (EB530, airline plates) FFB pedals seen from the pilot's side, front-left and above: left pedal at the upper left, right pedal at the lower right, FFB drive motor at the far right, rocker arm with HALL sensor in the middle
mappingSource: WinCtrl "Cyber Taurus 32 / Combat Rudder Pedals (CT.*.R) User Manual" section 3.2 Key positions drawing, page 8 (https://eu.winctrl.com/static/ipfs/QmNu2Koz6sDJ5YGgUVWx1fKTm4f85RW7kMBTQS9jdkFkwt): left toe brake = Ry, right toe brake = Rx (0-65535); main shaft 0-65535 drawn without an axis letter, so the rudder has no input in the catalog
note: Toe brakes are the pedal plates tilting on their lower hinges; markers sit on the upper (toe) half of each plate. The rudder marker sits on the rocker arm above the main shaft bearings.
